name: 95663 · Penryn, CA
findings: ZIP 95663 (Penryn) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95663 (Penryn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95663 (Penryn) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
